items.title: Trafford to start in Spain - but what are Tuchel's other selection issues?
items.excerpt: Against the best team in the world, Thomas Tuchel's defensive decisions will be key. And he has many to make.
body: Against the best team in the world, Thomas Tuchel's defensive decisions will be key. And he has many to make.

The England head coach said before Croatia at Wembley on Thursday that he was quite happy to go full-strength in both matches, despite the three-day gap, and he was true to his word. All the big guns were out for Harry Kane's big night.

Barring unexpected late injury or illness, the best player in the world will lead the line against the world champions. Morgan Rogers should start at right wing, Anthony Gordon left wing. England's Madrid maestro Jude Bellingham will play No 10, and Elliot Anderson and Declan Rice will form the double pivot. items.title: Big tactical calls and restricting Shaw - How Chelsea got better of Man City
items.excerpt: Chelsea leapfrogged champions Manchester City at the top of the Women's Super League table with a 1-0 victory at Stamford Bridge thanks to Sandy Baltimore's bullet first-half strike.
body: Chelsea leapfrogged champions Manchester City at the top of the Women's Super League table with a 1-0 victory at Stamford Bridge thanks to Sandy Baltimore's bullet first-half strike.

City were beaten for the first time this season having been clumsy all day - from a lacklustre first half, to wayward finishing in the second to goalkeeper Ayaka Yamashita's straight red card for a professional foul. The race for the WSL title is on.

Chelsea deserved the points - they were more at it than City on the day. They had the better of the first half with Ellie Carpenter, Melvine Malard and Alyssa Thompson all going close - before Baltimore smashed the Blues in front with a fierce finish from inside the box before half-time. items.title: Dowman breaks record after making England U21s debut in loss to Portugal
items.excerpt: Max Dowman broke Jude Bellingham's record to become the youngest player to represent England at U21 level but could not stop Lee Carsley's side from falling to a 1-0 loss against Portugal.
body: Max Dowman broke Jude Bellingham's record to become the youngest player to represent England at U21 level but could not stop Lee Carsley's side from falling to a 1-0 loss against Portugal.
Dowman, aged 16, 10 months and 13 days, stepped off the bench with around half an hour remaining to make his debut, but Moreira's first half strike secured the victory for Portugal on the evening.

Lee Carsley's side have now suffered successive defeats for the first time since March 2021 following their loss to the Republic of Ireland in their last European Championship qualifying match in October. items.title: Tearful Pochettino admits he 'couldn't say no to Man Utd'
items.excerpt: An emotional Mauricio Pochettino said that leaving his role with the United States was the "toughest decision of his career" but admitted he couldn't turn down the chance to become head coach of Manchester United.
body: An emotional Mauricio Pochettino said that leaving his role with the United States was the "toughest decision of his career" but admitted he couldn't turn down the chance to become head coach of Manchester United.

Pochettino has been appointed as Michael Carrick's replacement at Old Trafford having signed a deal until the summer of 2029. It comes mere months after extending his stay with the USMNT until the 2030 World Cup.
The Argentine will begin his new role on November 18, after taking charge of the USA's two fixtures against Haiti.

Speaking in his pre-match press conference before his penultimate game, Pochettino broke down in tears as he explained his decision. What will Pochettino's Man Utd team look like?
